Achha, pehle main dikhati hoon. Cricket pitch: ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman theek beech mein ruka; us jagah ka bhi number hai. Beech ka mark 0 se ek gap par hai, aur 0 se 1 tak 2 barabar gaps hain: isliye 1/2. Ab line 3 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. Wahan 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

Ab wahi sadak, 0 se 1, 6 barabar gaps mein bhi kati hai. Khilona us par pehle mark par ruka: kitne kilometre par?

Sahi jawab, kyunki marks se gaps ek zyada: 7 marks, 8 gaps. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par line par 8 barabar gaps hain. Gap zyada, toh har gap pehle se chhota hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, 0 se ek gap door. Ab wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein bhi kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

Bilkul sahi. Jitne zyada gaps, utna chhota har gap: 10 gaps ke saath pehla mark 1/10, 0 ke zyada paas aata hai. Ab ek sawaal milkar, ek-ek kadam karke dekhte hain. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 kilometre par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par hain. Board par abhi sirf beech wala khamba hai. 3 khambe raaste ko kitne barabar gaps mein kaatte hain?
